_note: Externally verified resolution of the four players who appear on two teams' 2026-27 books. Researched 2026-08-26 against SalarySwish (primary cap site), HoopsHype, and Hoops Rumors reporting. Every one is a real two-team situation, NOT a scrape artifact: a dead-money row on the old team plus a real contract on the new one. The contract table's error is that it copies the SAME salary to both rows.
_source_tier: spotrac_bref_realgm (SalarySwish/HoopsHype are cap-site tier) + reporter tier for the buyout terms

Bradley Beal.what_happened: Waived and stretched by Phoenix 2025-07-16 after a partial buyout in which Beal gave back $13,879,830. PHX dead money $19,383,010/yr for five seasons ($96,915,050 total). Signed with the Clippers, declined a $5.62M player option in June 2026, re-signed with LAC in August 2026 on 2yr/$13.2M (Y1 $6,424,800; Y2 $6,746,040 player option; 15% trade kicker).

Damian Lillard.what_happened: Waived and stretched by MILWAUKEE 2025-07-01 (not Portland). Signed with Portland 2025-07-19, 3yr/~$42M with a 2027-28 player option and a no-trade clause. Portland carries him as a real contract and has no Lillard dead money at all; its only 2026-27 dead cap is Didi Louzada at $268,032.

CONFLICT.description: The two cap sites disagree on Milwaukee's dead-money figure. Recorded per R8 rather than silently resolved.
CONFLICT.salaryswish_basis: applies an annual set-off credit of ~$1,205,551 against Lillard's new Portland salary
CONFLICT.why: The set-off is a real CBA mechanism and the site that models it is the more complete treatment. The difference is $1,205,550 on one team's apron basis and does not move Milwaukee across any threshold.

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope.active_salary_note: cap HIT is $2,449,421 (the reduced minimum-salary cap charge); actual salary is $3,876,529. The apron basis uses the cap hit.
Kentavious Caldwell-Pope.what_happened: NOT stretched. Exercised his $21,621,500 player option with Memphis in June 2026, then agreed a buyout and was waived 2026-07-25, giving back exactly $3,876,529. Because it was a buyout of an expiring deal and was not stretched, Memphis carries $17,744,971 for 2026-27 ONLY, with nothing after. He then signed a one-year minimum with Philadelphia.

Olivier-Maxence Prosper.what_happened: Waived and stretched by Dallas (SalarySwish dates the waiver 2025-08-29; some reports say Sept 2). Dallas declined the $5,259,383 team option for 2026-27 and stretched the remaining $3,007,080 across three seasons at $1,002,360/yr. Signed a two-way with Memphis 2025-09-04, converted to a standard two-year, $3,025,691 deal 2026-03-04.
